summary_en: GMO Prime Strategy raised FY2026 Dec. period-end dividend forecast by 1 yen to 23 yen per share. From FY2027 Dec., the company adopts a new dividend policy targeting payout ratio of 65% or higher on net income attributable to parent company shareholders, with DOE floor of 2%.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase) and Change in Dividend Policy from FY2027 Dec. onwards
translation_en_brief:
GMO Prime Strategy announced on November 13, 2026 that it is raising its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The period-end dividend per share has been increased by 1 yen from the previously announced 22 yen to 23 yen. The company's board of directors resolved to implement this revision to enhance shareholder returns while considering overall business performance and financial position.

In addition to the dividend hike, the company announced a change to its dividend policy effective from the fiscal year ending December 2027 onwards. The new policy establishes two concrete targets: (1) a payout ratio of 65% or higher based on net income attributable to parent company shareholders, and (2) a DOE (dividend-on-equity) floor of 2% on a consolidated basis. These targets replace the previous more general policy framework that referenced business performance, financial status, and investment plans without specific quantitative benchmarks.

The company stated that this change reflects its commitment to shareholder wealth maximization as a key management objective and its decision to implement stable and continuous dividend payments. By establishing these quantitative targets, the company aims to balance immediate shareholder returns with long-term share value appreciation.
